_ordering_rationale: Hero KPIs producteur gaz nat: volume vendu, prix realise, reserves prouvees. Capex en relais structurel.

kpis.signal: Top producteur gaz US, croissance +10,5% en 2024 dopee par Equitrans Midstream Merger
kpis.description_fr: Volume total vendu (gaz naturel + NGL + ethane + petrole en Mcfe equivalent). EQT est le premier producteur de gaz naturel des Etats-Unis (Marcellus Shale).
kpis.description_en: Total sales volume (natural gas + NGLs + ethane + oil in Mcfe equivalent). EQT is the largest US natural gas producer (Marcellus Shale).

kpis.signal: Prix realise incluant cash settled derivatives, lisse par hedges, sensible NYMEX et basis Appalachian
kpis.description_fr: Prix moyen realise par Mcfe (incluant cash settled derivatives). Driver direct de la revenue, sensible NYMEX, basis Appalachian, et programme de hedging.
kpis.description_en: Average realized price per Mcfe (including cash settled derivatives). Direct revenue driver, sensitive to NYMEX, Appalachian basis, and hedging program.

kpis.signal: Baisse 2024 sur production 2228 Bcfe + revisions negatives + cessions NEPA, 92% au Marcellus
kpis.description_fr: Reserves prouvees totales (gaz nat + NGL + petrole en Bcfe). 92% localisees au Marcellus Shale. Inventaire annees de drilling restant.
kpis.description_en: Total proved reserves (nat gas + NGLs + oil in Bcfe). 92% located in Marcellus Shale. Drilling inventory life.

kpis.signal: Hausse +17,7% en 2024 inclut Gathering + Transmission post Equitrans Merger
kpis.description_fr: Capex totales (Production + Gathering + Transmission + corporate). Discipline capital ralentie depuis merger Equitrans Midstream, guidance 2025 2,3-2,5 Mds $.
kpis.description_en: Total capex (Production + Gathering + Transmission + corporate). Capital discipline tempered since Equitrans Midstream merger, 2025 guidance $2.3-2.5B.

kpis.signal: Indicateur cadence production journaliere, depasse 6 Bcfe/j en 2024
kpis.description_fr: Volume moyen vendu par jour (Bcfe/jour). Indicateur de cadence operationnelle, depasse 6 Bcfe/j en 2024 dopee par acquisitions Tug Hill et Equitrans.
kpis.description_en: Average daily sales volume (Bcfe/day). Operational cadence metric, exceeded 6 Bcfe/day in 2024 boosted by Tug Hill and Equitrans acquisitions.

_notes: FY20 daily volume 4.1 et FY21 5.1 cites en highlights 10-K. FY22 5.31 = 1940 Bcfe / 365. Reserves end-of-year. Capex 2024 incl Gathering 202 + Transmission 31 post-merger.
